snippet.title: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA | Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
The latest Dragon Ball Game "DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA" is planned to launch on Tuesday, September 9, 2025 (PST)!
Seize Victory! 4vs4 Team Battle!

Don't forget to pre-register!
